name: LP333 family ID5 exact orbit anneal
hypothesis: A direct local search on the 113 multiplication orbits of subgroup {1,211,232} may find an exact fixed-family Legendre pair faster than generic CNF search because every state already satisfies subgroup invariance and the forced row-sum orbit margins.
evidence_unit: one deterministic 3600-second ID5 run at seed 20260727, with 2000000 equal-size opposite-sign orbit swaps per restart and exact integer scoring of all 166 independent full-length PAF residuals
claim_boundary: Only a serialized zero-objective pair independently verifying both full rows, subgroup {1,211,232} invariance, row sums one, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations is a candidate. A nonzero result does not close ID5 or any other family.

baseline.evidence: ID5 has exactly three singleton and 110 size-three coordinate orbits. Row sum one forces one negative singleton and 55 negative triple-orbits per row. The active pinned Kissat ID5 arm remains undecided.
baseline.measurement: At seed 20260727 the invariant initializer has squared residual 82080, L1 residual 3072, and maximum absolute residual 48.

intervention.one_change: Search directly in ID5 orbit-sign space: seven eighths of proposals swap opposite signs on two size-three orbits, one eighth swaps opposite singleton signs, and every move preserves subgroup invariance and row sums before exact incremental PAF scoring.
forbidden_confounds: accepting a nonzero or unaudited state

controls.name: exact-orbit-reconstruction
controls.purpose: Bind the search to source family ID5.
controls.expected: Closure of generator 211 modulo 333 reconstructs subgroup {1,211,232}, exactly three singleton and 110 triple orbits, and 113 total orbits.

controls.name: forced-row-sum-profile
controls.purpose: Ensure every state lies in the exact ID5 row-sum slice.
controls.expected: Each row has exactly one negative singleton and 55 negative triple-orbits, hence row sum one.

controls.name: incremental-multiflip-self-test
controls.purpose: Detect incorrect six-coordinate orbit-swap PAF updates.
controls.expected: Across 2000 deterministic singleton and triple-orbit swaps, every predicted PAF and objective equals a fresh O(333^2) recomputation while invariance and row sums remain exact.

controls.name: independent-full-result-audit
controls.purpose: Recompute the endpoint outside the C implementation.
controls.expected: A separate Python auditor reconstructs the subgroup orbits, both complete PAF vectors, row sums, orbit margins, objective, L1, maximum residual, status, source and binary pins, and a slice-preserving mutation.

controls.name: source-and-binary-pin
controls.expected: Source SHA-256 6d90f65980de930c66aa9e091f9fa0c329c0abb5248e07a7e8f5a2ebe81caad0, included exact-PAF baseline SHA-256 7a3bf72d06023658850d9e95ebc4d4eb0b3ba885da6d748a78abd5c297df486d, and binary SHA-256 cc2ebe205655ce9decab81f7e884e95303f5b6a1f1899a30f9d3c936c40c4938.

primary_metric.name: independently verified exact squared PAF residual reaches zero in ID5

terminal_outcomes.promote: The best squared residual is zero and the independent audit verifies ID5 invariance, row sums, and all 332 nonzero combined PAF equations.
terminal_outcomes.park: The frozen schedule completes with a valid independently audited nonzero endpoint.
terminal_outcomes.unknown: A process, memory, artifact, or verification ceiling interrupts the frozen schedule.
terminal_outcomes.audit-failed: Any subgroup, orbit, margin, delta, source pin, binary pin, stored-score, full-PAF, status, or mutation control fails.

stop_rules: Run only the pinned source and binary at seed 20260727.
Use 2000000 proposals per restart and the frozen 512-to-0.25 exponential temperature schedule.
Use exactly one singleton-orbit proposal every eight proposals in expectation through the frozen deterministic RNG branch.
Stop immediately at exact zero objective.
Otherwise stop at 3600 seconds without another seed, temperature, proposal mix, restart length, or cap.
Run the independent audit before interpretation.
Do not promote a lower nonzero score.

next_actions.promote: Freeze the pair, independently verify the Legendre equations again, construct H668, verify orthogonality and artifact hashes, and package it for the gated submission workflow.
next_actions.park: Archive the endpoint and use the paper's exact coset-DFS and partial-PSD pruning as the next distinct ID5 mechanism.
next_actions.unknown: Preserve the interruption and resume only the remaining frozen wall budget if reproducible.
next_actions.audit-failed: Repair only the smallest subgroup, orbit, delta, serialization, or verifier defect.

authority.data_scope: Local public-prompt artifacts, source-pinned code, and public primary literature are authorized for the autonomous campaign.
authority.external_actions: A fully audited H668 candidate may be prepared; actual external submission remains gated by exact destination, artifact, account, and contract terms.
